biotools.summary: ScaleSC is a GPU-accelerated single-cell RNA-seq data analysis pipeline designed for large-scale datasets. It leverages CuPy and CUDA to achieve significant speedups and scalability compared to existing tools like Rapids-singlecell, while maintaining compatibility with Scanpy workflows.
